propositions: Adapt existing deterministic repair and sentinel extraction from structured.parse_structured into a Pydantic TextOutput function that raises ModelRetry on retryable errors while preserving the original StructuredOutputError in the exception cause chain

Implement stop/refusal safety checks from structured.check_response through a Pydantic after_model_request capability hook that raises terminal UnretryableOutputError without triggering Pydantic retry prompts
Preserve parse_structured and check_response as pure parser authorities without adding retry loop logic, provider selection, or persistence to the new adapter module
Verify that valid native and prompted responses produce correctly typed objects through a real Pydantic Agent wired with the adapter
Confirm that historical repair and sentinel corpus produces identical values before and after the adapter integration
Ensure refusal responses abort after exactly one model call with no Pydantic retry prompts
